command.safety-flags.note: on `CommandDefinition` (`with_destructive`, `with_confirm_prompt`, `with_undoable`); grouped `_meta.actions` carries `destructive` and `undoable`, afd-detail all three; individual `_meta` omits them

command.approval-policy.note: `CommandDefinition::with_approval` (`ApprovalPolicy::when` for a function); `_meta` on `get_tool`, `afd-help` (full) and afd-docs

command.confirmations.note: `McpServer::with_confirmations`, individual, grouped and meta-tools; elicitation on 2026-07-28 and 2025 stdio

command.input-validation.note: legacy parameters or additive `register_with_schema`; use `get_tool` for authoritative discovery

command.output-schema.note: top-level `outputSchema` on individual and hybrid first-class tools (`with_advertise_output_schema`) and `_meta.outputSchema` in `McpServer`; `returns` not surfaced by `afd-schema`

views.command-metadata: , for commands with `returns` listed as their own tool, individual or first-class under hybrid (`McpServer::with_advertise_output_schema`)

single.active-context.note: `CommandRegistry::execute` enforces `with_active_context` or a `ContextStack` (depth 16), for batch items and pipeline steps too; MCP server keeps a stack per 2025 stdio connection, stateless HTTP mutation returns `SESSION_REQUIRED`

single.in-process-context.note: (#526): `CommandContext::with_active_context` for one call, or `with_context_stack` for a session; no in-process tool list or meta-tools

single.exception-redaction.note: a panic in `execute`, batch or pipeline (`execution_failure`), no dev mode; unwinding panics only (not `panic = "abort"` or wasm32); MCP server guards request panics with `INTERNAL_ERROR` (#531)

single.cancellation.note: cooperative `CancellationSignal` / `CancellationToken` on `CommandContext`, linked to per-call and server default `30000` ms (`default_timeout_ms`) deadlines; pre-cancelled single and batch calls return `COMMAND_CANCELLED` (#2130); `DirectClient` and `afd-pipe` deadlines fire a child of the caller's signal, never the caller's own; `execute_pipeline_with_cancellation` skips steps once its signal fires and fires it at the pipeline deadline (#1599)

single.clock-random.note: `fixed_clock`, `seeded_random` (same sequence as TypeScript); the registry fills both

single.actor.note: typed `actor_kind`; MCP server fills `agent`, DirectClient fills `human`; no testing package; middleware passes the context `next` runs with; pipelines take plain map context

single.context-fields-mcp.note: both eras over Streamable HTTP and stdio, after the context hook; `server/discover` and `afd-help`

views.cf-mcp: both eras over Streamable HTTP and stdio; the context hook wins; `server/discover` and `afd-help`

single.output-budgets.note: (Umbel phase 2 step 0b): `with_output_budget`, `with_output_budget_ask`, `output_budget()`, innermost `CommandRegistry::execute` check, journal `output_budget`; `tests/output_budget_vectors.rs` runs `spec/vectors/output-budgets.json`

single.journal-replay.note: (#426): `MemoryJournalSink`, `FileJournalSink` (`journal-file`, plus `journal-file-shared` OS lock; `AsyncFileJournalSink` with `native` runs it off the async threads), `CommandRegistry::set_journal` and `replay_journal`; matches `spec/wire/journal.jsonl` as JSON values

single.journal-range-last.note: ([#1597](https://github.com/lushly-dev/afd/issues/1597)); `#[non_exhaustive]` with a constructor, one breaking 0.x minor

single.journal-append-order.note: with the built-in sinks: the recorder awaits nothing before `append` and the sinks assign `seq` under a mutex; `AsyncFileJournalSink` takes a fair async lock before each append and holds it until the write returns (#1764); a custom async sink could reorder

single.journal-secret.note: `CommandDefinition::as_secret`; `CommandRegistry::execute` passes the declaration of the command it runs to the recorder, which records the call only with `with_redact` or `with_redact_info` (told `JournalRedactInfo { secret }`, always known); the call reads off every recording ancestor's tape, each marked `truncated`, also through a host's wrapper around a recording source and through `CommandDefinition::execute`

middleware.tracing-compose.note: (#1600): `compose_middleware`; tracing middleware is N/A: a host wraps calls in `tracing` or OpenTelemetry spans in its own middleware

middleware.approval.note: (`create_approval_middleware`, `approval` feature, default; tokens verify across languages)

middleware.approval-fail-closed.note: ([#1886](https://github.com/lushly-dev/afd/issues/1886), #2029): `CommandRegistry::execute` refuses unadmitted calls; `ApprovalMiddlewareOptions::from_secret` makes the command list optional

middleware.direct-approval.note: (#460): approval-aware `DirectClient.call` with async hook, one total deadline; raw registry remains a trusted host API

middleware.approval-relay.note: (Umbel phase 5 step 0d): `ApprovalMiddlewareOptions::with_relay(ApprovalRelay::McpElicitation)`; one principal-bound `requestState` per call with confirmation answers; in band on a 2025 stdio connection

views.approvals: (Umbel phase 5 step 0d: `ApprovalMiddlewareOptions::with_relay(ApprovalRelay::McpElicitation)`; one principal-bound `requestState` per call; in band on 2025 stdio)

middleware.up-front-approval.note: on 2026-07-28 and in band on a 2025 stdio connection; nothing is kept, since validation computes no default

views.approvals: (on 2026-07-28 and in band on a 2025 stdio connection)

mcp.tool-fields.note: annotations (`mutation: true` only), `structuredContent` on every route's result, and top-level `outputSchema` on individual and hybrid first-class tools (`with_advertise_output_schema` opts out); #465

views.cm-structured: (`McpServer`, every tool result of every route, meta-tools, batch and pipeline included)

mcp.transport-context.note: `McpServer::with_context_hook`, async, sees HTTP request parts (none on stdio) and may refuse with a `CommandError`; runs once per call before confirmation gate; sees verified `credentials` with `server-auth` and cannot change them

mcp.auth.verification.note: (#798, `server-auth` feature, needs Rust 1.88): `McpServer::authorized_http_service` behind `BearerLayer`, `JwtVerifier` (`jsonwebtoken`/`aws-lc-rs`), `KeySource`, `StaticKeys`, `JwksKeySource` (over a host `JwksLoader`), `TokenVerifier`, `check_introspection`, `ProtectedResource`, `CommandContext::credentials`, fail-closed M1; loads `spec/authorization.json`

mcp.auth.scopes.note: (#798, #835): command `scopes`, `ScopeResolver` (`resolve`, `visible`, `known`), pre-dispatch 403 on `tools/call`, `INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE` after routing and at execution, `filter_tools_by_scope`, hidden commands unknown on every route, `McpServer::pre_dispatch_check`, per-caller `ResourceProvider::list_for`/`read_for`; loads `staticScopes` and `batches`

views.command-metadata: (Umbel phase 5 step 0b: `CommandDefinition::with_scopes`, checked at registration, in `_meta`, grouped `_meta.actions` and `afd-detail`; enforced with `server-auth`)

mcp.confirmation-principal-binding.note: (step 0c): HMAC associated data over the command, input and principal binding (the hook's actor and `CommandContext::credentials`); since step 0d the form-mode approval relay's answers share the state

views.command-metadata: (step 0c): the hook's actor and `CommandContext::credentials`, in the state's HMAC associated data; since step 0d the same state carries the form-mode approval relay's answers
views.auth-m8: (step 0c; `afd::principal_binding` in the gate's associated data; step 0d: the approval-relay state, `RelayCall::principal_binding` and relay evidence too)

mcp.host-verified-confirmation.note: (Umbel phase 5 step 0d): `CommandDefinition::with_confirmation_mode(CommandConfirmationMode::HostVerified)`, `HumanRelay` trait on `McpServer::with_human_relay` (single-command 2026-07-28, validated input, URL-mode elicitation), relay evidence spent once by `create_approval_middleware`, `afd::input_digest`
